subject: Access Bridge Microgrant Authorization - fastlane attendee credits
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia@codesummit.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@edgescale.io>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 09:15:12 -0700
Subject: Fastlane attendee follow-up + ask for starter credits

Thanks Rishi — great talk at the Access Bridge track yesterday. A quick favor: a handful of our speakers had last-minute guests who couldn't register in time. Would Redwood be open to sending 50 "fastlane" starter credits (30k tokens each) per guest for ~5 attendees to get them onboarded and try the integration quickly?

EdgeScale has been pushing the session materials and we think getting these folks on trial will convert faster. I realize this is out of band; happy to have procurement sign a short addendum or accept a memo we can cc back.

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Partnerships, CodeSummit / EdgeScale Events

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia@codesummit.io>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 11:02:03 -0700
Subject: Re: Fastlane attendee follow-up + ask for starter credits

Hi Olivia — congrats on a packed room, and thanks for the heads up. I can make the ask internally but need written approval for an exception to the standard promo pool (we typically require 10-person minimum or partner credit agreement). Can you confirm the guest names and emails and whether this is for conversion (post-demo) or purely onboarding?

If EdgeScale can sign a short acknowledgement (I can draft), we can consider a one-off microgrant of up to 250 starter credits across the group. I'll loop in finance ops and Naomi to check budget impact.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 08:30:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Fastlane attendee follow-up + ask for starter credits

Rishi — quick notes from ops: bulk promo credits need PO or partner MOU for >200 starter credits. For a 250-credit exception we'd need a short approval memo from sales leadership and an accounting entry for promotional expense. If the ask is smaller (<=150) we can do a straight allocation from the marketing promo pool.

Can you confirm the business justification and whether EdgeScale will accept a usage cap (e.g., 30k tokens per code) and 90-day expiry? Attach a proposed allocation CSV and I'll route to accounting for sign-off.

Naomi Feldman
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia@codesummit.io>, Samir Patel <samir@edgescale.io>
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 10:12:57 -0700
Subject: Re: Fastlane attendee follow-up + ask for starter credits

Thanks Naomi — TL;DR: EdgeScale requests 5 guest codes (50 starter credits each) = 250 total to be issued as single-use promo keys capped at 30k tokens and 90-day expiry. Rationale: these are vetted VIPs (speakers' guests) and conversion likelihood >40% based on prior post-event cohorts. EdgeScale will accept an acknowledgement letter (I can put together the short MOU) and a CSV list of recipient emails.

Attached: edgescale_fastlane_codes.csv (draft of codes + intended recipients) and MA-approval-memo.pdf (short draft I propose for legal/ops). Request: Naomi / Vanessa — approval to allocate 250 starter credits as a one-time microgrant and to let me distribute single-use codes via EdgeScale's event portal.

Thanks — I can route the MOU to Legal if you give the green light.

— Rishi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: edgescale_fastlane_codes.csv (csv, 5 rows), MA-approval-memo.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 16:05:00 -0700

Approved as exception — allocating 5 single-use starter codes (50 credits each) from December promotional reserve under internal approval ES-06-26-RM. Conditions: (1) codes expire 90 days from issuance, (2) EdgeScale to send back signed acknowledgement (we need to retain for audit), (3) marketing to tag conversion cohort with campaign=edgescale_fastlane.

Rishi — please share final signed MOU and I will confirm accounting posting and push codes to the promo system. Naomi — I sent a short note to finance ops to expect the posting.

Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
